candidate.name: MCL Dual-Book First-Passage Probation
candidate.base: Every exact V18 basis_breadth admission enters at the unchanged next-minute matched-MCL open with unchanged direction, branch, costs, roll law, raw-turn boundary, failed-auction profit memory, and natural cadence.
candidate.state: From the entry-minute open, accumulate causal CL and matched-MCL open-to-current-close movement. Disagreement or a zero move leaves probation unresolved.
candidate.favorable_first: The first completed minute where both cumulative moves share V18 direction graduates the position into the unchanged V18 lifecycle.
candidate.adverse_first: The first completed minute where both cumulative moves oppose V18 may abort at the next matched-MCL minute open when that action precedes the frozen original exit.
candidate.unresolved: If neither joint direction resolves before the original boundary, V18 remains unchanged.
candidate.after_abort: Remain flat until the next authentic V18 admission; never synthesize re-entry.

architectural_distinction: Unlike the rejected V47 add-on confirmation, no entry is delayed or suppressed and no separate signal is introduced. V18 already owns the position; the dominant discovery and executable transport books form one post-entry fail-fast risk state that can only shorten an adverse first passage.
outcome_law: The census may expose only categorical first-passage direction, causal timing, and counts because those are the proposed live state transition. Do not read or group PnL, MFE, MAE, win rate, return magnitude, drawdown, or validation economics. Only a complete independent-period count pass may freeze one exact discovery lifecycle; validation remains sealed until that lifecycle passes every absolute and relative-to-V18 economic gate.
prohibitions: no V18 entry delay, suppression, direction, branch, route, parity, maturation, cadence, roll, cost, profit-memory, or ordinary-exit change

no magnitude, tick, clock, bar-count, persistence, CL-only, MCL-only, open-close versus close-close, favorable/adverse subset, branch, direction, lane, ownership, ATR, slope, velocity, basis, phase, session, stop, target, timeout, or sizing sweep
no reverse, add-on, re-entry, news authority, quota, order, or capital authority
no PnL/MFE/MAE during count and no validation PnL unless later discovery passes
